data.description:
Placeholder for the feedback-loop pillar of the test creation calibration North Star (was 643f-7f3a).

Goal: when an issue is caught by code review or surfaces as a production bug rather than by the test suite, the test-writing agent's prompts and heuristics learn from the miss. Concretely: a mechanism that converts review findings / bug tickets into test-creation guidance (per-skill prompt augmentation, behavioral-testing-standard.md updates, or a curated negative-example library), so the suite catches a measurable share of issues currently surfaced only by code review or production bugs.

Out of scope: generation-time prevention (sibling epic); suite-growth-vs-coverage metrics (sibling epic); post-hoc phantom-mapping detection (c13f-6196).

Refine via /dso:brainstorm.
data.title: Test creation calibration (c): feedback loop from production bugs and review findings to test-creation prompts
